changeSet.author: jobapp

preConditions.onFailMessage: job_entry rows still use job_type ORACLE; change them to another type first
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_entry WHERE job_type = 'ORACLE'

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE job_entry DROP CHECK chk_job_entry_job_type
ALTER TABLE job_entry ADD CONSTRAINT chk_job_entry_job_type CHECK (job_type IN ('WORKDAY', 'DIGICERT', 'AKAMAI_ORACLECLOUD'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE job_entry DROP CHECK chk_job_entry_job_type
ALTER TABLE job_entry ADD CONSTRAINT chk_job_entry_job_type CHECK (job_type IN ('WORKDAY', 'DIGICERT', 'ORACLE', 'AKAMAI_ORACLECLOUD'))
